cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
· Review customer documentation and communicate with customer as needed
· Review MPI against customer requirements, and suggest appropriate changes to make it user-friendly and mistake proof
· Actively review and analyze the daily defects, historical defects and work with cross functional teams to prevent/reduce defects
· Identify manufacturing problems or inefficiencies in the manufacturing process
· Performs Internal audits and initiates corrective actions and follow-ups to audit findings (i.e. ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 14001 & ISO 13485).
· Perform risk assessment and work to mitigate the identified risk
· Review the DFM report and ensure that the identified issues have been resolved before starting the build
· Monitor the build closely to ensure that the process controls are in place
· Conducting process audit to ensure that the quality controls are maintained
· Lead the CAPA
· Work with suppliers and purchasing team for the supplier quality requirements and supplier quality issues
· Provide training to the operators/QC inspectors to enhance the knowledge of people
· Review and ensure that the deviations are properly understood and implemented
· Make suggestions on process and quality improvement to Quality Engineering Manager
· Drive the execution of quality goals and objectives
· Drive the actions to meet the internal and external customer requirements
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College graduate with 2+ years of experience in quality engineering, or high school diploma with 5+ years of experience in quality engineering
Certified for industry workmanship standard (IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001)
Good communication skills in English
Proficient at reading and interpreting blueprints, drawings, bills of material, etc.
Good understanding of BOM structure and document control activity
Good understanding of material traceability
Proficient with MSWord, Excel and Outlook
Good problem-solving skills
Preferred Requirements
Excellent technical knowledge of PCB Assembly processes
J-STD-001 Space addendum experience
Expertise in APQP, PPAP, Control Plans, FMEA
Knowledge of SPC and Measurement System Analysis
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0272.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team.
cond_0272.responsibilities:
· Review customer documentation and communicate with customer as needed
· Review MPI against customer requirements, and suggest appropriate changes to make it user-friendly and mistake proof
· Actively review and analyze the daily defects, historical defects and work with cross functional teams to prevent/reduce defects
· Identify manufacturing problems or inefficiencies in the manufacturing process
· Performs Internal audits and initiates corrective actions and follow-ups to audit findings (i.e. ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 14001 & ISO 13485).
· Perform risk assessment and work to mitigate the identified risk
· Review the DFM report and ensure that the identified issues have been resolved before starting the build
· Monitor the build closely to ensure that the process controls are in place
· Conducting process audit to ensure that the quality controls are maintained
· Lead the CAPA
· Work with suppliers and purchasing team for the supplier quality requirements and supplier quality issues
· Provide training to the operators/QC inspectors to enhance the knowledge of people
· Review and ensure that the deviations are properly understood and implemented
· Make suggestions on process and quality improvement to Quality Engineering Manager
· Expertise in APQP, PPAP, Control Plans, FMEA will be a plus
· Knowledge of SPC and Measurement System Analysis will be a plus
· Drive the execution of quality goals and objectives
· Drive the actions to meet the internal and external customer requirements
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College graduate with a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated expertise in quality engineering, or high school diploma with a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated expertise in quality engineering
Certified for industry workmanship standard (IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001)
Strong command of reading and interpreting blueprints, drawings, bills of material, etc.
Advanced knowledge of BOM structure and document control activity
Advanced knowledge of material traceability
Exceptional communication skills in English
Strong problem-solving abilities
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of PCB Assembly processes
J-STD-001 Space addendum experience
Expertise in APQP, PPAP, Control Plans, and FMEA
Proficiency in SPC and Measurement System Analysis
Strong command of MSWord, Excel, and Outlook

cond_0513.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team.
cond_0513.responsibilities:
· Review customer documentation and coordinate with customers as needed
· Review MPI against customer requirements, and suggest appropriate changes to make it user-friendly and mistake proof
· Actively review and analyze daily defects and historical defects, and work with cross-functional teams to prevent or reduce defects
· Identify manufacturing problems or inefficiencies in the manufacturing process
· Perform internal audits, initiate corrective actions, and follow up on audit findings (i.e. ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 14001 & ISO 13485)
· Perform risk assessment and work with the team to mitigate identified risks
· Review the DFM report and help ensure that identified issues have been resolved before starting the build
· Monitor the build closely to help ensure that process controls are in place
· Conduct process audits to ensure that quality controls are maintained
· Coordinate the CAPA process
· Work alongside suppliers and the purchasing team on supplier quality requirements and supplier quality issues
· Provide training to operators and QC inspectors to build team knowledge
· Review and help ensure that deviations are properly understood and implemented
· Share suggestions on process and quality improvement with the Quality Engineering Manager
· Support the execution of quality goals and objectives
· Coordinate actions to meet internal and external customer requirements
cond_0513.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
College graduate with 2+ years of experience in quality engineering, or high school diploma with 5+ years of experience in quality engineering
Certified for industry workmanship standard (IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001)
Good communication skills in English
Proficient at reading and interpreting blueprints, drawings, bills of material, etc.
Good understanding of BOM structure and document control activity
Good understanding of material traceability
Proficient with MS Word, Excel and Outlook
Good problem-solving skills
Preferred Requirements:
Excellent technical knowledge of PCB Assembly processes
J-STD-001 Space addendum experience
Expertise in APQP, PPAP, Control Plans, and FMEA
Knowledge of SPC and Measurement System Analysis
